title: Dance with Maths, Accessible Mathematics Workshop, Divya Jyothi Trust
teaser: "Dance with Maths" workshop on accessible mathematics for sight-impaired students at Divya Jyothi Charitable Trust, Mysuru, by Mr. B.S. Krishnamurthy.
homepageMatter: On 10 January 2026, Mr. B.S. Krishnamurthy conducted a "Dance with Maths" workshop on accessible mathematics for sight-impaired residents of Divya Jyothi Charitable Trust, Mysuru, using tactile learning materials and mathematical verses.
